newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo names James O'Neal CEO of Frito-Lay.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo names James O'Neal CEO of Frito-Lay.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc. said Friday it named James O'Neal to the newly created positions of president and chief executive of Frito-Lay International, with responsibility for all PepsiCo snack operations outside North America.
O'Neal has been president and CEO of PepsiCo Restaurants International since 1995, the company said.
Before the restaurant position, O'Neal spent 30 years in the corporation's U.S. and international snack businesses.
Frito-Lay International, with 1996 sales of over $3 billion, is one of PepsiCo's fastest growing businesses and is its most profitable international unit, the company said.
In January, PepsiCo announced it was spinning off its Taco Bell, Pizza Hut and KFC fast-food operations, which include O'Neal's international unit.
